JUUSOLA1995.citation: Juusola M, Uusitalo RO, Weckstrom M (1995) Transfer of graded potentials at the photoreceptor-interneuron synapse. J Gen Physiol 105(1):117-148
JUUSOLA1995.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; only numbers stated in the text are used
JUUSOLA1995.species: BLOWFLY Calliphora vicina, NOT Drosophila (cross-species, disclosed)
JUUSOLA1995.recording: intracellular R1-6 and LMC voltage; light steps in the dark, contrast steps and pseudorandom contrast at backgrounds over 6 log units (non-motion)

numbers.synaptic_amplification_contrast_steps: LMC peak / R peak for contrast steps falls ~2.5-fold, from ~10 to ~4, when the background rises 3.5 log units (Fig. 8C text); the brightest background is ~500,000 photons/s, the lowest ~160 photons/s
numbers.dark_adapted_LMC_saturation: on-transients saturated by small steps, 40-58 mV below the dark rest; R steps saturate at 55-70 mV

JUUSOLA1995.mapping: blowfly brightest tested background -> Drosophila BG0; 3.5 log units dimmer -> BG-3.5. Declared, not fitted.
